lines.text: The Pharisees go out and conspire to trap Jesus in His words.
The Pharisees send their disciples to Jesus along with the Sadducees.
They ask whether it is lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, and Jesus, knowing their evil intent, calls them hypocrites.
They bring Jesus a shekel, and He asks whose image and inscription are on it.
Jesus tells them to give to Caesar what is Caesar’s and to God what is God’s, and they leave amazed.
